python3 << 'EOF'
import csv
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('eu_economic_data.csv')))
for r in rows:
    r['GDP_Billion_EUR']=float(r['GDP_Billion_EUR']); r['GDP_Growth_Pct']=float(r['GDP_Growth_Pct'])
    r['Unemployment_Pct']=float(r['Unemployment_Pct']); r['Inflation_Pct']=float(r['Inflation_Pct'])
    r['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR']=float(r['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR']); r['Public_Debt_Pct_GDP']=float(r['Public_Debt_Pct_GDP'])

eu = [r for r in rows if r['Country']=='EU_Total']
print("EU totals:")
for r in eu: print(f"  {r['Year']}: GDP {r['GDP_Billion_EUR']:.0f}B, growth {r['GDP_Growth_Pct']}%, unemp {r['Unemployment_Pct']}%, infl {r['Inflation_Pct']}%, trade {r['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR']:.1f}B, debt {r['Public_Debt_Pct_GDP']}%")
g22 = eu[0]['GDP_Billion_EUR']; g24 = eu[2]['GDP_Billion_EUR']
print(f"  GDP cumulative growth 22-24: {(g24/g22-1)*100:.1f}%")
print(f"  Inflation decline 22->24: {eu[0]['Inflation_Pct']-eu[2]['Inflation_Pct']:.1f} pp")
print(f"  Trade balance improvement: {eu[2]['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR']-eu[0]['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR']:.1f} B EUR")
print(f"  Debt reduction: {eu[0]['Public_Debt_Pct_GDP']-eu[2]['Public_Debt_Pct_GDP']:.1f} pp")

print("\n2024 by country (sorted by GDP):")
for r in sorted([x for x in rows if x['Country']!='EU_Total' and x['Year']=='2024'], key=lambda x:-x['GDP_Billion_EUR']):
    print(f"  {r['Country']:12s} GDP {r['GDP_Billion_EUR']:7.0f}B  growth {r['GDP_Growth_Pct']:+.1f}%  unemp {r['Unemployment_Pct']:4.1f}%  infl {r['Inflation_Pct']:.1f}%  trade {r['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR']:6.1f}B  debt {r['Public_Debt_Pct_GDP']:.1f}%")

print("\nGrowth by country by year:")
for c in ['Germany','France','Italy','Spain','Netherlands','Poland','Sweden']:
    vals=[r['GDP_Growth_Pct'] for r in rows if r['Country']==c]
    print(f"  {c:12s} 2022 {vals[0]:+.1f}  2023 {vals[1]:+.1f}  2024 {vals[2]:+.1f}")
EOF
ls -la && echo "---" && wc -l eu_economic_report.md && echo "---" && grep -c "svg" eu_economic_report.md
